title: Review
line: Find callers outside the diff before you ship.

beats.caption: You ask what else the changed helper can affect.
Review lists the callers outside your diff.
beats.label: pi-review

beats.caption: The agent names a check for the CLI caller.

takeaway.title: Check an outside caller
takeaway.line: Use the review report to decide what else to exercise.

title.text: A small edit to a shared helper can reach code that never appears in your diff.

scene.text: The agent uses Review to look up callers of the changed greeting helper. The command line entry point is on the list, so that’s a path you can check before shipping.

takeaway.text: Use the callers as a guide. Pick a check that actually goes through the part of the program they use.
